doc_friction.issue: Step 4b says to turn a defect into a check under platform/ci/, but no workflow runs the platform/ci test_*.py glob (only the local checklist does), so a new test_*.py there never runs in CI without a control-plane workflow edit. Hooking the check into run_venture_tests.py (already run by ventures-tests.yml) avoided that; the prompt could name this route.

All 4 'open' defects from redteam.py open already had open control-plane PRs awaiting the owner; the tool does not show that, so each run re-searches. redteam.py open could print a linked PR when the issue text names one.

real_defects.issue: readSpec looked up CARRY_OVER_PICK[f.carryOverPick] with no own-key check: carryOverPick 'constructor' (or toString, __proto__) gave the search a function as its pick, every try scored NaN, bestCarryOverRounds returned no rounds and buildSchedule threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading map)'. Fixed with Object.hasOwn; bestCarryOverRounds now refuses a pick that is not a finite number >= 0 instead of returning a result with no rounds.

costSegEstimate({propertyType: 'constructor'}) found Object.prototype instead of falling back to multifamily: year1Extra, cumTaxSaved and the other figures came back null. Reachable through the agent tools / MCP server (platform/agents/tools.mjs call). Fixed with Object.hasOwn.
landedByDestination with product or destination 'constructor'/'toString' threw a raw TypeError instead of returning 'Choose a garment type.' / 'Choose a destination.'. Fixed with Object.hasOwn.
parse accepted level 'constructor' as a level of edit (no 'Choose a level of edit.' error) and condition 'toString' as a manuscript condition. Fixed with Object.hasOwn.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: mutation campaign triage, 4 small fixes with tests, a lint with ratchet and runner hook, a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
